author: Joe Scott
description:
My team and I are doing the first ever live event where they will pitch me ideas for stories and you’ll get to learn right along with me! There will be jokes, drinks, and shenanigans, and audience members will be able to interact in real time. 

Here are the deets:

Friday, November 13 at 7:00pm
Deep Ellum Art Company in Dallas
3200 Commerce Street

Tickets now available here: https://app.opendate.io/e/answers-with-joe-november-13-2026-778841
title: Live show, Friday November 13!
